groups.name: wow.view-store
groups.description: The view store service's settings (`wow.view-store`, the 9.x starter's prefix).

properties.name: wow.view-store.system-views
properties.description: The read-only system views the service serves (ConfiguredSystemViews), each with its `tenant-id` and `app-id` (blank for every one), its `id` (not starting with `system:`), its `definition-id`, its `title` and its `config`, the engine's view configuration as JSON text.
